rows.note: Use this for a connected passage or tract in the body, such as the digestive tract.

example.english: My digestive tract is having problems, so I often get stomachaches.
example.traditional: 腸胃管道出問題，成日肚痛。
example.jyutping: coeng4 wai6 gun2 dou6 ceot1 man6 tai4 seng4 jat6 tou5 tung3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a small informational booklet or a short written treatise.

example.english: This tract is about preventing older people from falling.
example.traditional: 呢本小冊子係講點樣防止長者跌親嘅。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 siu2 caak3 zi2 hai6 gong2 dim2 joeng2 fong4 zi2 zoeng2 ze2 dit3 can1 ge3

rows.note: Use this construction for an expanse or area of a physical thing, such as sea or land.

example.english: When we reached the mountaintop, a vast tract of sea lay before us, looking absolutely beautiful.
example.traditional: 行到山頂，眼前就係一片海，靚到不得了。
example.jyutping: haang4 dou3 saan1 deng2 ngaan5 cin4 zau6 hai6 jat1 pin3 hoi2 leng3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5
